title: Template:2SEBracket/doc
wikitext:
{{2SEBracket}} == Use == : ''Template for a single-elimination bracket with 2 players'' * One round, 2 players. * Variables are R1D1 and R1D2 for the players, with the addition of "race" and "score" for the races and scores. * Race variable uses the first letter of the race, p z t r or bye. *To '''bold''' winners and winners' scores use: |R1D1=Playername |R1D1score=2 '''|R1D1win=1''' *To '''customize the names of the Round''' (default: Round 1) use: |R1= *To '''remove the round title''' completely use: |hideroundtitles=true *To customize '''column width''' or '''score width''' use: |column-width= |score-width= *To add information about maps, link to vods, a short note, etc. use (See [[Template:BracketMatchSummary]] for further details): * '''Overtime:''' If a map went to overtime, add |map#ot=1. The value 1 equals the number of consecutive overtimes, rarely more than 1. * '''Walkover:''' If a player leaves WO, add |R#D#race=wo. Can also be set to red, green, blue, yellow and white - please avoid this if you can. == Copy/Paste ==
